summary.text: If your MediSave Account is below the cohort BHS at 65, you do not have to top it up.

details.heading: No top-up is required
details.body: If your MediSave Account balance is below the cohort Basic Healthcare Sum at age 65, you do not have to top it up.

details.heading: You may top up
details.body: If you want to build up your healthcare savings, you can choose to top up your MediSave Account with cash.

example_phrasings: What happens if I do not have the Basic Healthcare Sum when I turn age 65?
Do I have to top up my MediSave at 65?
What if my MediSave is below the Basic Healthcare Sum?

sources.page_title: What happens if I do not have the Basic Healthcare Sum when I turn age 65?

quotes.text: If your balance is less than the cohort BHS at age 65, you are not required to top up your MA.
However, if you wish to build up your healthcare savings, you can choose to top up your MA with cash.
